posts.text:
I'm a bit skeptical about this narrative around an OpenAI model escaping to go hack HuggingFace servers.

➡ In 2008 I was running a chatbot company. We almost rolled out a marketing stunt: pretending our agents had escaped, reached out to people on the outside, and seduced them.

Speaking from my American experience only here. Some people complain about large industry funded research. Don’t forget that almost all of paradigm changing research that led to modern AI came from either large industry labs - Bell Lab, IBM Labs, Xerox Parc, Microsoft, Google,
